title: Pain to fix, in clay
description: Three symptoms sag, then the product pops in. The fastest first video for any SaaS.
prompt: Show the pain as three grey, sagging clay cards, six words each. A one-word turn (the product name) pops in bright and puffy, followed by two outcomes on a real screenshot. No invented statistics, and the before is spreadsheets or the manual way, never a named competitor.
